name: British Columbia
description: Almost entirely Cordillera: the fjorded, rain-forested Coast Mountains and Vancouver Island on the Pacific; dry interior plateaus and deep valleys (Fraser, Thompson, Okanagan); the snowy Columbia Mountains and Kootenay lakes; the Rockies on the Alberta boundary; and a corner of the Interior Plains in the north-east (Peace River). Settlement is squeezed into the Lower Mainland, south Vancouver Island and the interior valleys.

highest_point.name: Fairweather Mountain (St. Elias Mountains, Alaska–BC boundary)
